mapper.sql: SELECT m.material_id, m.material_no, m.material_type, m.title, m.content, m.file_url, m.file_name, m.file_size, m.tags, m.activity_id, m.use_count, m.user_id, m.material_status, m.del_flag, m.create_by, m.create_time, m.update_by, m.update_time, m.remark, a.activity_name, u.nick_name as user_name FROM mk_material m LEFT JOIN mk_activity a ON m.activity_id = a.activity_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON m.user_id = u.user_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mk_material (material_no, material_type, title, content, file_url, file_name, file_size, tags, activity_id, use_count, user_id, material_status, create_by, create_time, remark) VALUES (#{materialNo}, #{materialType}, #{title}, #{content}, #{fileUrl}, #{fileName}, #{fileSize}, #{tags}, #{activityId}, IFNULL(#{useCount}, 0), #{userId}, #{materialStatus}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.update: UPDATE mk_material SET del_flag = '2' WHERE material_id IN #{materialId}
